config.source:
SELECT
  f.psgc_code,
  f.year,
  f.indicator_code,
  f.cmci_name,
  f.geographic_level,
  f.raw_score,
  d.pillar_name,
  d.indicator_name
FROM gold.fact_cmci_indicator f
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_cmci_indicator d ON f.indicator_code = d.indicator_code

WITH latest_region AS (
 SELECT psgc_code, region FROM gold.fact_ldrrmf
 WHERE psgc_code IS NOT NULL AND region IS NOT NULL
 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY psgc_code ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, ldrrmf_fact_key DESC) = 1
), population AS (
 SELECT psgc_code, year, total_population FROM gold.fact_population
 WHERE year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM gold.fact_population) AND psgc_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT lm.psgc_code, lm.lgu_name, COALESCE(lm.province_name, 'No province assignment') AS province_name,
 COALESCE(lr.region, 'Region unavailable') AS region, lm.income_classification, lm.geographic_level,
 pop.total_population, r.population_exposure_score, r.earthquake_activity_score, r.risk_score,
 r.risk_tertile, COALESCE(r.risk_level, 'Not scored') AS risk_level,
 p.cmci_capacity_score, p.ldrrmf_utilization_score, p.preparedness_score, p.preparedness_gap,
 p.preparedness_tertile, p.preparedness_gap_rank, p.cmci_year, p.fiscal_year,
 COALESCE(v.priority_category, 'Not classified') AS priority_category,
 COALESCE(r.population_year, pop.year) AS population_year, r.risk_window_start, r.risk_window_end, r.calculated_at,
 r.run_id,
 CASE WHEN r.psgc_code IS NULL THEN 'LGU absent from Platinum'
      WHEN r.population_exposure_score IS NULL THEN 'Population unavailable'
      WHEN r.earthquake_activity_score IS NULL THEN 'Earthquake components unavailable'
      ELSE 'Scored' END AS risk_status,
 CASE WHEN p.psgc_code IS NULL THEN 'Snapshot unavailable or inconsistent'
      WHEN p.cmci_capacity_score IS NULL AND p.ldrrmf_utilization_score IS NULL THEN 'CMCI and LDRRMF unavailable'
      WHEN p.cmci_capacity_score IS NULL THEN 'CMCI incomplete or unavailable'
      WHEN p.ldrrmf_utilization_score IS NULL THEN 'LDRRMF unavailable or zero denominator'
      ELSE 'Scored' END AS preparedness_status
FROM reference.lgu_master lm
LEFT JOIN latest_region lr ON lm.psgc_code = lr.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN population pop ON lm.psgc_code = pop.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN platinum.risk_level_by_lgu r ON lm.psgc_code = r.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN platinum.preparedness_gap_by_lgu p ON lm.psgc_code = p.psgc_code AND r.run_id = p.run_id
LEFT JOIN platinum.vulnerability_priority_by_lgu v ON lm.psgc_code = v.psgc_code AND r.run_id = v.run_id
WHERE lm.is_active = true AND lm.geographic_level IN ('City', 'Mun', 'Municipality', 'City/Municipality')

measures.name: risk_scored_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_score IS NOT NULL THEN psgc_code END)

measures.name: preparedness_scored_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN preparedness_score IS NOT NULL THEN psgc_code END)

measures.name: unscored_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_score IS NULL OR preparedness_score IS NULL THEN psgc_code END)

measures.name: highest_priority_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN priority_category = 'Highest priority' THEN psgc_code END)

SELECT d.indicator_code, d.pillar_name, d.indicator_name,
 p.cmci_year, p.mean_indicator_percentile, p.priority_lgu_count, p.priority_rank,
 CASE WHEN p.indicator_code IS NULL THEN 'No calculated highest-priority cohort' ELSE 'Calculated' END AS coverage_status
FROM gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
LEFT JOIN platinum.cmci_preparedness_priority_by_indicator p ON d.indicator_code = p.indicator_code
 AND p.run_id = (SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM platinum.vulnerability_priority_by_lgu)

lines: Experimental v1: relative percentiles and tertiles; approximate 2023 boundaries. Missing required inputs remain unscored. Population density, income class and infrastructure are not components of the risk formula.

lines: Preparedness = CMCI capacity + LDRRMF utilization. Gap = preparedness − risk, ranked descending as approved. The scales differ: this is an experimental ordering aid, not a calibrated deficit. Incomplete inputs remain null; source years are shown.

frame.title: LGU preparedness components, source years and gap

lines: ## Which LGUs have high risk and low preparedness?
Highest priority = high-risk tertile and low-preparedness tertile. Compare the two score axes separately; their scales differ. LGUs lacking either component remain Not classified, not Lower priority.

frame.title: Highest priority LGUs — top 20 descending gaps

lines: ## Which preparedness indicators should be prioritized?

Lower CMCI indicator percentiles identify relative weaknesses within the calculated highest-priority LGU cohort. Priorities are grouped by CMCI year. If no eligible cohort exists, the approved indicators remain listed without fabricated priority scores.
